headline.text: L1 Matrix 9 *screw* caught by X-ray after bagging — investigation open on equipment source.

summary: Two metal events at L1: screw found in bagged product from Matrix 9, and S3 metal detector non-functional for 36 minutes during production. Six sanitation re-cleans across L1 and L3 after failed ATP or visible residue.

holds.title: Kirkland date code error — 6 pallets
holds.summary: Wrong best-by date printed on flow-wrap (31.03.26 vs correct 20.07.27); 6 pallets isolated pending rework decision.
holds.status: On hold; quantity and rework plan under review.

holds.title: Plastic container in supplier cookie box
holds.summary: Grinding team found plastic container inside inbound cookie box; assumed supplier filling tool; box isolated.
holds.status: Box on hold; supplier notification pending.

food_safety.title: S3 metal detector non-functional 36 minutes
food_safety.summary: Air system turned off during belt inspection; metal detector did not reject from 08:01 to 08:37 during production run.
food_safety.status: Resolved at 08:37; 36 minutes of product ran without metal detection. Disposition TBD.

food_safety.title: Screw in Matrix 9 bagged product
food_safety.summary: X-ray caught screw in flow-wrapped bag from Matrix 9 during QA check; line lead inspecting equipment for source.
food_safety.status: Investigation open; equipment inspection in progress to locate source.

food_safety.title: Cookie debris in cleaned sweco
food_safety.summary: ML4 crew found cookie pieces inside sweco during installation; sweco was bagged with passed ATP/visual tag; cleaned before install.
food_safety.status: Resolved — QA inspected, crew removed all debris before installation.

food_safety.title: Belt fraying before ML4 metal detector
food_safety.summary: Significant fraying observed on conveyor belt upstream of metal detector; potential for fiber/belt material entry into product.
food_safety.status: Maintenance working on replacement at window close.

quality.title: S2 metal detector constant false rejects
quality.summary: Metal detector continuously triggering and rejecting product; no metal confirmed on inspection.
quality.status: Ongoing — line supervisor notified for troubleshooting.

quality.title: S4 guillotine cut variation
quality.summary: Intermittent piece-size variation on one THG row; belts too close together and guillotine belt slightly crooked.
quality.status: Belts gapped, rollers cleaned; awaiting test run to confirm fix.

quality.title: S1 insufficient chocolate coverage
quality.summary: Multiple pieces showing thin/bare spots on bottom; operator adjusting enrober settings.

quality.title: ML1 glycogen gauge stuck at 1
quality.summary: Glycogen gauge reading only 1; maintenance called to troubleshoot sensor or connection.

sanitation.title: S3 Matrix 3 multiple ATP failures
sanitation.summary: Matrix 3 failed ATP three times on bottom-of-mold testing after initial sign-off; re-cleaned each time.
sanitation.status: Resolved after third clean; root cause of repeated failure unknown.

sanitation.title: S3 Matrix 5 ATP failure
sanitation.summary: Matrix 5 failed ATP on bottom-of-mold after initial pass-off; re-cleaned and retested.

sanitation.title: S3 pistachio residue after cleaning
sanitation.summary: Pistachios visible on Matrix top area after cleaning sign-off; area re-cleaned.
sanitation.status: Resolved — area re-cleaned and confirmed clear.

sanitation.title: ML4 refrigerator 2 not cleaned
sanitation.summary: Cooling cabinet 3 (listed as refrigerator filling 2) marked complete but not cleaned; discovered at 3rd shift startup.
sanitation.status: Resolved — QA passed after 1st shift completed clean.

sanitation.title: ML4 pre-heat cabinet incomplete clean
sanitation.summary: Pre-heat cabinet marked complete but visible residue remained; 3rd shift had to re-clean before startup.

sanitation.title: ML4 chocolate flush failures — 3 totes
sanitation.summary: Oil flush on changeover failed QA twice (still showing dark chocolate); required third tote of oil to clear system.
sanitation.status: Resolved after third flush; passed QA and moved to chocolate push.

allergen.title: S3 Tunnel 1 allergen test passed
allergen.summary: Tunnel 1 belt held pending allergen verification after cleaning; test passed, released to production.
allergen.status: Resolved — allergen test passed, line released.

opportunities.text: Consider adding daily metal-detector air-system confirmation to S3 pre-op — today's 36-minute non-function resulted from air being turned off during belt inspection.
Review Matrix ATP procedure after three failures on Matrix 3 and one on Matrix 5 following initial sign-off — bottom-of-mold testing scope may need clarification.
Add Matrix 9 hardware inspection to startup checklist — today's screw in bagged product suggests equipment integrity check gap.
Review ML4 cleaning sign-off process — two sections marked complete but not cleaned (pre-heat cabinet, cooling cabinet 3) delayed 3rd shift startup.
Consider oil-flush target spec or visual standard for ML4 chocolate changeovers — three totes required today vs typical one or two.
